title: Detailed gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Bag body -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="60" rx="4" fill="#E85D75"/>
  <!-- Bag body lighter shade highlight -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="60" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FF8FA3" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Bag bottom fold -->
  <rect x="20" y="80" width="60" height="10" rx="4" fill="#C94A61"/>
  <!-- Side crease left -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="6" height="60" rx="3" fill="#D14E65"/>
  <!-- Side crease right -->
  <rect x="74" y="30" width="6" height="60" rx="3" fill="#D14E65"/>
  <!-- Bag top opening -->
  <rect x="18" y="28" width="64" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- Ribbon left loop -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="24" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#4CC9F0" transform="rotate(-20 38 24)"/>
  <!-- Ribbon right loop -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="24" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#4CC9F0" transform="rotate(20 62 24)"/>
  <!-- Ribbon knot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="6" fill="#3AA8C9"/>
  <!-- Ribbon tail left -->
  <path d="M46 32 Q38 42 34 52" stroke="#4CC9F0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ribbon tail right -->
  <path d="M54 32 Q62 42 66 52" stroke="#4CC9F0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Heart on bag -->
  <path d="M50 60 L46 55 Q42 50 46 47 Q50 44 50 48 Q50 44 54 47 Q58 50 54 55 Z" fill="#FFD166" stroke="#FFE599" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Pattern dots -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="78" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- Sparkle top left -->
  <path d="M28 22 L29 25 L32 26 L29 27 L28 30 L27 27 L24 26 L27 25 Z" fill="#FFE599"/>
  <!-- Sparkle top right -->
  <path d="M72 18 L73 21 L76 22 L73 23 L72 26 L71 23 L68 22 L71 21 Z" fill="#FFE599"/>
</svg>
